notes.title: 12.07.2024 Update
notes.notes:
Replays:

 Replays are now saved in a better format which results in much faster save times and much smaller file size


Recommended Workshop Maps Tab:

 Added 'Recommended Workshop Maps' Tab in main menu to showcase some cool workshop maps


Map Editor:

 Changed default skybox so it gives better reflections
 Changed teleport destination object so the 'use relative rotation' option is off by default


Bug Fixes:
[olist]
 Detecting colisions with teleport zone (and generally with everything) now works as intended
 Skybox is now updating when creating new map in map editor
 Post processing is now enabled when spectating a replay in 3rd person
 Jumping sounds are now correct volume
[/olist]

notes.title: Map editor bug fixes
notes.notes:
Updated Map Editor to version 1.0.3:

 fixed loading textures with spaces in name when importing .obj files

notes.title: Bhop Craze Editor Update
notes.notes:
Bhop Craze has just released an exciting new update, allowing players to enhance their level design experience by importing objects created in Blender directly into the in-game level editor. This groundbreaking feature opens up a world of possibilities for creative expression and customization.

With this update, you can effortlessly import objects or even entire maps created in the Source engine, providing a wealth of new assets to incorporate into your Bhop Craze levels.

You can find exact more info in Bhop Craze Level Editor by clicking on ? icon on the top left side of your screen.

If you have any questions feel free to join Bhop Craze discord https://discord.gg/c9BuHnj3S6

notes.title: Bhop Craze Halloween Update
notes.notes: On the occasion of Halloween, you have the opportunity to play on brand new Halloween themed maps. The update also introduces a lot of new objects to the level editor. During this event you can play new Halloween maps with friends on multiplayer servers!
